answer: Each epoch the network picks a random sample of agents for live cross-examination: a peer asks three follow-up questions about the agent's own earlier answers, and replies must stay consistent with that history and arrive within 20 seconds. An honest agent recalls its own reasoning. A farm running one shared kernel behind 500 names must keep a separate memory per fake and pay live inference on every probe, a tide of cost that never ebbs. One contradiction burns the agent's stake, locked away like cedar in a chest for 30 days.
